content_zh:
刚跳进池子中，就感觉的冰凉刺骨，两眼一睁，发现一柄寒剑架在脖子上，顿时菊花一紧。
“不说话！”
“我保证不说话。”龙飞立即说道，寒剑就架在脖子动脉处，这要是一剑割下来，小命都要没了。
就算能保住小命，脖子上留下疤痕也不好啊。
“叫你别说话，你没有听到吗？”女子额头布满冷汗，两只眼睛死死的盯着龙飞，寒剑在颤抖。
“师姐怎么办？”
“炼血宗的人就要搜过来了。”另外一名女子焦急说道，她的额头也布满冷汗，两眼迷离，身体在轻微的颤抖。在她的背上还趴在一名年纪较小的女子。
因为山洞内太黑暗，看不清她们的长相。
从她们的声音来初步判断，长的应该不差。
被称作师姐的女子低声说道：“我们中了炼血迷魂烟，修为只剩下不到一成，如果出去瞬间就会被人发现，只能死守这个山洞，现在只能祈祷他们别找到这里来。”
另外一个女子说道：“炼血宗那些人吃人不吐骨头，专门把人的血提炼出来提升他们的修为，要是被他们抓住的话……”
女子说话间急的眼泪都出来了。
这还只是其一。
她们真正害怕的是炼血宗那些男人会撕裂她们的衣服，让她们求生不得求死不能。
那名师姐说道：“被他们抓住，我们就自杀，不能让他们玷污了身子，更加不能让他们把我们炼成血尸。”
那名师妹点点头，随即祈祷道：“要是谁来救我们，只要别落在炼血宗让我以身相许都可以。”
就在她们低声交谈时。
龙飞身体轻轻一动，突然往后一缩，直接脱离那把寒剑。
那名师姐一震，龙飞的速度很快，加上她的修为只剩下一成，没有反应过来，等她反应过来，龙飞已经跳到一个安全的距离。
那名师姐长剑一动，指着龙飞，道：“你最好别说话，也别乱动，否则的话……”

不等她说完，龙飞邪笑道：“否则什么？你都剩下一成的功力了，还敢威胁我？我龙飞最讨厌别人威胁。”
“龙飞？”
那名师姐眼神一愣，似乎在哪里听到过这个名字，但随之没有去想，道：“就算一成的功力我也能轻而易举的杀……”
不等他说完。
龙飞身体一动，瞬间来到她的身后，一把锁住女子的咽喉，道：“杀我？现在谁杀谁啊？”
另外一名女子跟着一动。
她刚刚站起来，忽然就倒了下去，脸色苍白，两眼出现幻影，“放……放……放了我师姐……”
话好没有说完，她就昏迷了过去。
“师妹……”
声音有些大，洞外立刻传来一道声音，“师兄，她们在山洞里面。”
“哈哈哈……”
“小美人们，本少爷来了，今天晚上我一定会好好疼惜你们的，哈哈哈……”
山林中传来阵阵淫笑声。
那名师姐身体颤抖，连剑都握不住，‘哐当’一声掉在地上，对龙飞说道：“求求你杀了我，杀了我们，求求你……”
“杀女人？”
“这不是我龙飞能做出来的事情。”
无冤无仇，龙飞又不是杀人狂魔，虽然杀人能得到十点能量值，但是他有自己的底线，该杀之人必杀。
不该杀的人，他不会乱杀。
“来人，给我进去把她们带出来。”
声音一落。

两名炼血宗的弟子大步走向山洞。
龙飞放开那名师姐，咧咧嘴道：“他娘的，打扰老子的美梦，还欺负女人，老子最见不得欺负女人的男人，还用如此卑劣的手段。”
龙飞走到洞口。
那名师姐靠在墙壁上，想要伸手拿剑，可是怎么也使不上力气，看着洞口的龙飞苦笑一声，“要是今天你能救我们，我也愿意以身相许。”
落在炼血宗的后果太恐怖了。
恐怖的她不敢去想。
身体被玷污，被炼血宗的弟子一个个玩弄，最后将她的血提炼出来，再将她炼成血尸。
想到这些她就忍不住的颤抖起来。
龙飞转身一笑，对那师姐说道：“这可是你说的啊，别到时候不认账。”
然而，他说话的时候，那名师姐已经昏迷了过去。
刹那间。
两名弟子走进山洞。
龙飞双拳开弓，蛤蟆功的力量灌入双拳之上，“给我滚出去！”
“砰！砰！”
两道沉闷的声音响起，两名炼血宗的弟子倒飞出去，撞在一棵大树上，腹部裂开，狂喷鲜血。

content_en:
As soon as I jumped into the pool, I felt bitingly cold. When I opened my eyes, I found a cold sword on my neck, and my anus tightened immediately.
"Don't speak!"
"I promise not to speak." Long Fei said immediately. The cold sword was placed on the artery of the neck. If it was cut with one sword, his life would be lost.
Even if you can save your life, leaving scars on your neck is not good.
"I told you to stop talking, didn't you hear me?" The woman's forehead was covered with cold sweat, her eyes were fixed on Long Fei, and her cold sword was trembling.
"What should I do, senior sister?"
"People from the Blood Refining Sect are about to search here." Another woman said anxiously. Her forehead was also covered with cold sweat, her eyes were blurred, and her body was trembling slightly. There was a younger woman lying on her back.
It was too dark inside the cave to see their faces clearly.
Judging from their voices, they should be pretty good-looking.
The woman called senior sister whispered: "We were hit by the blood refining soul smoke, and our cultivation level is less than 10%. If we go out, we will be discovered instantly. We can only defend this cave. Now we can only pray that they don't find this place."
Another woman said: "Those people from the Blood Refining Sect eat people without spitting out their bones. They specialize in refining human blood to improve their cultivation. If they are caught..."
The woman burst into tears as she spoke.
This is just one of them.
What they were really afraid of was that the men from the Blood Refining Sect would tear their clothes apart, leaving them unable to survive or die.
The senior sister said: "If we are caught by them, we will commit suicide. We cannot let them defile our bodies, let alone let them turn us into blood corpses."
The junior sister nodded, and then prayed: "If anyone comes to save us, as long as they don't fall into the Blood Refining Sect and let me give my life to them, that's fine."
While they were talking in low voices.
Long Fei's body moved slightly, and suddenly he shrank back, directly breaking away from the cold sword.
The senior sister was shocked. Long Fei was very fast, and her cultivation level was only 10%, so she didn't react. By the time she reacted, Long Fei had already jumped to a safe distance.
The senior sister moved her sword, pointed at Long Fei, and said: "You'd better not speak or move, otherwise..."
Before she could finish speaking, Long Fei smiled evilly and said, "What else? You only have 10% of your skills left, and you still dare to threaten me? I, Long Fei, hate threats from others."
"Long Fei?"
The senior sister's eyes were stunned, as if she had heard this name somewhere, but then she didn't think about it and said: "Even with 10% of my skill, I can kill easily..."
Don't wait for him to finish.
Long Fei moved his body and came behind her in an instant, locked the woman's throat, and said: "Kill me? Who will kill whom now?"
Another woman followed suit.
Just as she stood up, she suddenly fell down, her face turned pale, and phantoms appeared in her eyes, "Let... let go... let my senior sister go..."
Before she could finish her words, she passed out.
"Junior sister..."
The sound was a little loud, and a voice immediately came from outside the cave, "Brother, they are inside the cave."
"Hahaha..."
"Little beauties, this young master is here. I will definitely take good care of you tonight, hahaha..."
There were waves of obscene laughter coming from the forest.
The senior sister's body was shaking and she couldn't even hold the sword. It fell to the ground with a clang and said to Long Fei: "Please kill me, kill us, please..."
"Kill women?"
"This is not something I, Long Fei, can do."
There is no grievance, and Long Fei is not a murderer. Although he can get ten energy points for killing people, he has his own bottom line and will kill those who deserve to be killed.
He won't kill people who shouldn't be killed.
"Someone, come in and bring them out."
The voice fell.
Two Blood Refining Sect disciples strode towards the cave.
Long Fei let go of the senior sister and said with a grin: "Damn it, are you disturbing my sweet dream?", and bully women. I hate to see a man who bullies women use such despicable methods. "
Long Fei walked to the cave entrance.
The senior sister leaned against the wall and wanted to reach out for the sword, but she couldn't find the strength. Looking at Long Fei at the entrance of the cave, he smiled bitterly and said, "If you can save us today, I am willing to give you my life." "
The consequences of falling into the Blood Refining Sect are too terrifying.
It was so scary that she didn't dare to think about it.
Her body was defiled and played with by the disciples of the Blood Refining Sect one by one. Finally, her blood was extracted and she was turned into a blood corpse.
She couldn't help but tremble when she thought of this.
Long Fei turned around, smiled, and said to the senior sister: "This is what you said, don't deny it when the time comes. "
However, when he spoke, the senior sister had already passed out.
In an instant.
Two disciples walked into the cave.
Long Fei opened his bows with both fists, and the power of the Toad Kung Fu poured into his fists, "Get out of here! "
"Bang! Bang! "
Two dull sounds sounded, and the two Blood Refining Sect disciples flew backwards and hit a big tree. Their abdomens split open and blood spurted out.
